description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-09-11, together with the three compact Sales Report routes added by #1379, so routeManifestAdditions carries only the Phase 4 authoritative proforma-capacity read route and any other new route still fails until it is reviewed and folded in the same way. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The source-text allowance covers assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records, led by the #1193 entry in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression. The three #1196 assertions in tests/supplier-partner-net-position-inclusion.test.ts that this file used to carry were removed by #1200, so the ceiling drops with them.

sourceTextAssertionDelta.rationale: Each entry asserts a contract that has no behavioural surface. The mobile-responsive files (phase1-critical-flows, wave2-factory-floor, wave3-erp-operations) assert on Tailwind breakpoint classes and data-testid template literals: jsdom applies no CSS, so which of the mobile and desktop views is visible at a breakpoint is only expressible as source text. realtime-wave2-live-page-policy asserts the ABSENCE of polling and of a second WebSocket in live pages — an absence no request can demonstrate. proforma-capacity-concurrency-wiring asserts that every proforma-linked creation path takes the capacity lock before it writes, and that the lock is taken first; ordering inside a transaction is not observable from outside it. company-deletion-contract asserts that storage.ts composes the dependency-aware deletion service rather than a second implementation, which is a wiring fact, not a result. factory-loading-soft-delete-overload-regression asserts that soft-deleted proformas and orders are excluded from the shared capacity snapshot and that both scan and bulk-import source their counts from it; the exclusion is a SQL predicate, so there is no request that can distinguish it from a count that happens to be equal. sales-report-compact-routes asserts that every sales-report URL the BUILT client fetches is mounted by the live stats registry: build/viteSalesReportBandwidthPlugin rewrites those URLs at build time, so the endpoints under test do not appear in the running test process at all and the contract is only expressible by running the transform over source. maxAdditionalTextAssertions is measured exactly at 154 over the reviewed baseline of 2061, so any further growth still fails.
